issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED likely does not exist on the upstream client enum
issues.detail: The diff changes `_enable_vad` to check `EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED` and `EndOfUtteranceMode.EXTERNAL`. `TurnDetectionMode.FIXED` is being added locally, but `EndOfUtteranceMode` comes from the speechmatics client SDK. If `FIXED` is not a member there, this will raise AttributeError at import/init time on every instantiation, breaking the service entirely.

issues.description: Default change to FIXED is a silent breaking behavior change for existing users
issues.detail: Previously default was `EXTERNAL`; now `FIXED`. Existing applications that relied on the default and pushed `UserStoppedSpeakingFrame` for finalization will silently stop finalizing (the handler now only reacts to `VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame`). This is a behavioral regression that deserves a clear migration note in the changelog beyond the one-line bullet.

issues.description: split_sentences is forwarded twice via different mechanisms
issues.detail: `split_sentences` is included in the generic loop that setattr's known keys onto `config` (line 501), and then `config.speech_segment_config` is also explicitly set from `params.split_sentences`. If the client config has a top-level `split_sentences` attribute, both paths run; if not, the loop is a no-op. Either way, the dual write is confusing and risks divergence.

issues.description: SpeechSegmentConfig unconditionally overwrites any user-provided segment config
issues.detail: `config.speech_segment_config = SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=params.split_sentences or False)` runs every time, discarding any other fields a future user might set on speech_segment_config and forcing `emit_sentences=False` when the param is None. Consider only setting it when split_sentences is not None, or merging.

issues.description: Warning log message references frame type that user did not send
issues.detail: When `_enable_vad` is true and a `VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame` arrives, the warning says it was received "but internal VAD is being used". This is the expected pipeline behavior in VAD-internal modes, not a misconfiguration, so the warning will be noisy. Consider downgrading to debug or removing.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics call moved but not removed
issues.detail: The `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` line was simply relocated within `_handle_start_of_turn`. Dead commented code should either be deleted or wired up; leaving it in obscures intent and produces churn in future diffs.

review.summary: The PR adds a `FIXED` turn detection mode and a `split_sentences` parameter, and switches finalization to `VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame`. The most pressing concern is that `_enable_vad` now references `EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED`, which is an upstream SDK enum — if `FIXED` isn't defined there, instantiation will crash. Beyond that, the default-mode change is a silent behavioral break for existing integrations, and the `split_sentences` config is wired through two paths that risk drift. A few smaller cleanups around log levels and dead comments would tighten this up.
